segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Priya. I had you down for adding 18 service seats and moving the reporting package from standard to advanced for the July 15 go-live. Is that still the right scope?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. We’re at 42 seats today, and the support managers want 60 total. The only thing I need clear is the invoice timing, because our fiscal month closes July 31.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. The quote I sent this morning has the 18 added seats prorated from July 15 through your current term ending March 31, 2027. It’s $14,280 for the seat add and $9,600 for advanced reporting, so $23,880 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what finance expected. Can you split it so the one-time onboarding for reporting is a separate line? It helps them code it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, it’s already broken out as subscription and one-time services. The onboarding line is $2,400, and the subscription portion is $21,480. Same invoice, separate lines.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On terms, procurement asked if the add-on follows our current master agreement, no new auto-renew language or anything.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. It’s a co-termed order form under the existing agreement, same payment terms, net 30, and no change to renewal language. I included that note in the order form under special terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If I sign by Friday, can your team still do the admin training the week of July 8?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. We reserved July 9 at 1 p.m. Central for the admin session and July 11 for the reporting workshop. Once the order form is signed, the kickoff invite goes out with those dates.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send me the final PDF, and I’ll route it today. Assuming legal doesn’t redline the company address or something silly, we should have it back by Thursday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the final PDF right after this call. Just to confirm, billing contact is still invoices at northlake-holdings dot com and the PO number is NH-4472?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that’s the one. Thanks, Mark.
